checks.cmd: cd / && rc=0; sha256sum -c --quiet /root/.interaction/baseline_schema.sha256 || rc=1; diff <(sort /root/.interaction/baseline_schema.listing) <(find /app/altair/vegalite/v6/schema -type f -not -path '*/__pycache__/*' | LC_ALL=C sort) || rc=1; exit $rc
